title: Juki DDL-8700-7
subtitle: 1-Needle Lockstitch Machine with Automatic Thread Trimmer (B-7 Control Family)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Juki DDL-8700-7 is the standard 1-needle lockstitch machine in the DDL-8700 family, equipped with automatic thread trimmer and the new compact servomotor (M92). Designed for medium-weight woven fabrics in general apparel production.
applications: General straight-stitch seaming on shirts, blouses, trousers, light workwear
Operations requiring automatic reverse-feed stitching and bobbin counter
Production lines with energy-saving mode and program-support features
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (woven), shirt production, trouser production, light industrial textile assembly

overviewDescription: Made by Juki (Japan). The DDL-8700-7 ships with the SC-920C control box and M92 compact servomotor (450 W) as the standard set. It inherits the desirable features of the previous Juki lockstitches — high-speed stitching, ease of operation, reliability — and adds energy-saving mode, output control function, operation measuring function (six modes), and bobbin counter. Sub-variants: DDL-8700A-7 (light-weight), DDL-8700H-7 (heavy-weight). Note: this is the standard `-7` trimmer version; for the integrated direct-drive variant see Juki DDL-8700B-7.
